retrievalProfile.description: A four-panel grid layout featuring individual portraits with rounded corners and a central overlapping serif title.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist flat design is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical 2x2 grid of four distinct photographic portraits, each housed in a frame with heavily rounded corners, set against a textured warm-toned background with a large central serif wordmark that overlaps the inner edges of all four images.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical quadrant grid for subject balance
Central typography acting as a visual bridge between panels
Unified warm color grading across disparate photos
Rounded corner frames contrasting with sharp serif letterforms

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four equal-sized portraits occupying the quadrants of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, high-contrast white serif text at the center intersection.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular movement from top-left clockwise, anchored by the central text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Thin gutters between the rounded frames and a textured border around the perimeter.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and tan background tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in hair and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the central typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a focus on mid-tone warmth and soft highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'y' with a deep, looping tail
Italicized or slanted orientation for the main wordmark
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant display face; secondary metadata in small sans-serif if needed.
graphicDevices: Subtle paper or fabric texture overlay

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary stroke contrast and elegant serifs.
Classic high-fashion feel consistent with 90s R&B aesthetics.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 2x2 grid of four portraits with soft lighting and warm sepia tones. Each portrait should be inside a square with heavily rounded corners. The background behind the squares should be a textured tan or light brown fabric-like surface.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large, high-contrast white serif wordmark in the center of the grid, ensuring it overlaps the inner corners of all four portraits. Use a font with elegant swashes.

verificationChecks: Are there exactly four rounded-corner portraits?
Is the central text white and high-contrast serif?
Is the overall color palette warm and sepia-toned?
Does the text overlap the images?

adjustableVariables: Corner radius of the image frames
Intensity of the sepia color grade
Degree of swash/decoration on the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Confirm the grid is 2x2 and symmetrical.
Check that the white text is legible against the images.
Ensure the rounded corners are consistent across all four frames.
Verify the warm, nostalgic color cast is uniform.
recipe.reuseFormula: Quadrant Grid + Rounded Masks + Central High-Contrast Serif + Sepia Grading
